A_filter_combinations.how: logical AND of the verified single-filter masks (high_cagr/fb/m_*.py). Only the six filters whose single run raised full Calmar are combined: confirmation.B, volume.A, htf_trend.B, squeeze.A, breadth.A, adx.A. This choice uses the round-1 results, so it is in-sample by construction; that is why the holdout below exists.
A_filter_combinations.combos: all 15 pairs of those six + two triples: confirmation.B+volume.A+htf_trend.B and confirmation.B+volume.A+squeeze.A (17 candidates)
A_filter_combinations.gate: same as predeclared_fb.json except the false-breakout check uses cost in % of equity (cut >= 15%), fixing the dollar-metric flaw found in round 1

initial_stop.A: initial stop 1.5 x ATR instead of 2

pyramid.B: pyramid add risk 0.5 x (instead of 0.35), safe check kept

B_non_filter_ideas (Sonnet agents, bench.gate: imp_harness.verdict: @2 and @5bps positive H1/H2/2026, full Calmar >= baseline+0.05, full DD <= baseline, Calmar >= baseline in H1 and H2; Calmar not worse on old-5 and new-10

C_holdout.symbols: the next 10 symbols by Sep-2021 quote volume after the stage-2 picks, same requirements as predeclared_stage2_universe.json (continuous data 2021-08..2026-10-04, active LBank USDT swap, no stablecoin/index). Never used before in this project.
C_holdout.who_goes_there: at most: every in-sample PASS from A and B, the round-1 standout confirmation.B, and the baseline. Nothing is tuned on the holdout.
C_holdout.holdout_gate: HOLD10 universe, 4 slots, R=0.75%: full Calmar >= baseline+0.05 at 2bps AND 5bps, net > 0 in H1, H2 and 2026 at 2bps
C_holdout.decision: Only a holdout pass is recommended for the bot, and only with the user's confirmation.
